paper.title: Code as Policies: Language Model Programs for Embodied Control
paper.central_claim: Code as Policies uses pretrained code-generating language models to synthesize executable robot policy programs from language, recursively defining helper functions and composing perception/control APIs with precise computation and feedback, enabling generalization across instructions and embodied domains.
paper.central_claim_son55_wording: Code-writing LLMs, few-shot prompted with hints and instruction-to-code examples, can write robot policy code (perception-conditioned feedback loops, geometric reasoning with NumPy/Shapely, parameterized control primitives) executed directly on robots; hierarchical code generation (recursively defining undefined functions) improves code generation benchmarks and robot tasks without training.
